messages:
Anya: Heads-up: enterprise customer requires EU-only inference for their EU tenants and insists on the EU-quantized model variant (p6q-eu). Need a routing contract that enforces region boundary and handles missing variants.
Tom: Clarify: is soft-residency acceptable (data may leave region for prefetch/control-plane), or strict local-only execution?
Anya: Strict local-only for inference and model weights. Control plane metadata ok if anonymized. Legal flagged this as mandatory.
Chris: That implies we must never route to non-EU pools for that tenant. If the exact variant binary isn't in EU artifact storage, we must reject, not silently fallback.
Maria: Also the quantized EU binary could diverge slightly; apps may want a compatibility hint. Suggest adding X-Model-Compat header with a compat-score and a code explaining the difference.
Tom: Draft routing policy idea: priority list = 1) tenant+region+variant exact match, 2) tenant+region+compatible variant (per catalog compat matrix), 3) reject with structured error JSON pointing to self-serve mirror request docs. No cross-region fallback.
Chris: Define "compatible variant" precisely. Different quantization (int8 vs int4), different kernels, small FP differences... we need a catalog-driven compatibility matrix.
Anya: Model-catalog stores per-variant metadata: variant_id, family, quant-level, tokenization-id, deterministic-similarity-threshold. Catalog API returns a boolean compat and a numeric diff-estimate. Versioned manifests.
Maria: Implementation for proxy: read X-Model-Variant or X-Model-Family headers, check local catalog cache. If variant unknown locally, return 412 with body: "variant-unknown: control-plane-syncing". 
Tom: For cold regions, we could offer artifact mirroring but only if the artifact already exists in EU artifact storage. We cannot transfer binaries from non-EU to EU on-demand without explicit operator action.
Chris: Agreed. We allow an async mirror request flow: customer hits a CLI/API to request EU mirror; ops run INF-xxxx mirror job which validates provenance and mirrors into EU blobstore. Until mirrored, routing rejects.
Anya: Telemetry: emit counters gauge: variant_missing{tenant,model_family,region}=1 increment, and response header X-Model-Status with values [ok, compat, missing, unknown]. Also log a short sample payload diff when compat used.
Maria: Canary testing: support X-Canary-Model=true for whitelisted tenants. Still enforce regional artifact presence. Canary must be opt-in and auditable.
Tom: Edge case: what if the catalog says compat=true but quantized outputs differ in ways that break downstream safety filters? We should include a preflight test harness that runs a small verification suite when compatibility is declared for a tenant. If failure, mark compat=false for that tenant until manual review.
Chris: Ops/bot: deploy-bot please ensure model onboarding pipeline publishes signed manifests to regional artifact stores and model-catalog updates atomically.
deploy-bot: ticket INF-2389 created: "artifact-mirroring-checklist + signed-manifest-publish".
Anya: Action items: @Tom write routing-service PR with policy and response codes by EOD Wed; @Chris add compatibility matrix schema + catalog endpoints; @Maria add metrics + X-Model-Status header contract and sample payload logging; Ops to implement CLI mirror request doc.
Tom: I'll open the PR tomorrow morning. No objections?
Chris: LGTM. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks, this keeps audit and legal happy. We'll follow up if catalog model forensics changes.
